blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A suspect in the fatal shooting of a 41-year-old pharmacist along V. Rama Avenue in Barangay Calamba was arrested in Toledo City hours after the incident in a hot pursuit operation by the Cebu City Police Office (CCPO). Authorities identified the suspect as Jerome Abella, who was tracked down and apprehended in Toledo City. The victim, Marjorie Llaguno, 41, was walking along the busy thoroughfare after finishing her shift when she was attacked.
